changeSet.author: sydorenko
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE sp_calc_enrollment_completed_lessons AS BEGIN UPDATE e SET e.completed_lessons_count = ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lesson_completion lc WHERE lc.enrollment_id = e.id ) FROM enrollment e; END;

rollback.sql: UPDATE enrollment SET completed_lessons_count = 0; DROP PROCEDURE sp_calc_enrollment_completed_lessons;
